description: This file defines the AnswerRepository interface, a Spring Data JPA repository for managing Answer entities. It extends JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and includes a custom method findByQuestionId to retrieve answers based on question ID.

classes.name: AnswerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Answer entities, providing CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByQuestionId
methods.description: Returns a list of Answer objects associated with a specific question ID.
